name: Suika GBA Edition
summary: A homebrew fruit-merging puzzle game that brings classic Suika game-style physics puzzle action to the GBA handheld. Players drop fruits into a container and combine matching pairs to evolve them up a chain of larger fruits - starting from cherries and progressing all the way to watermelons - while managing space so the pile does not overflow the top of the box. The game features next-fruit previews, score and high-score tracking, and a compact, pick-up-and-play interface.
